SCTP::client_port
Description
Returns the SCTP port/service number of the specified client. This
command is equivalent to the command
clientside { SCTP::remote_port
}
.
Syntax
SCTP
::
client_port
SCTP::client_port
Returns the SCTP port/service number of the specified client.
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
if
{
[
SCTP
::
client_port
]
>
1000
}
{
pool
slow_pool
}
else
{
pool
fast_pool
}
}
